entities.summary:
Taisho University  is a private university in Nishi-sugamo, Toshima, Tokyo, Japan. The university was founded in the last year of the Taishō period (1926) by merging the three Buddhist colleges. The three were:the Tendai-shū College,
the Buzan College, and
the Religious College.
